caption: The drawing depicts a single rectangular wooden chest with a hinged lid, rendered in shades of light brown and tan to represent the natural wood grain. The chest features black or dark gray metal hardware, including corner reinforcements, a keyhole in the center of the front panel, metal brackets on the sides, and a handle on the right side. The chest is set against a plain, off-white background with no additional objects or decorations present. The bottom of the chest has a simple molding detail along its edge, and the overall perspective shows the front and right sides of the chest. The artist's name "DWYER" appears in small, uppercase letters to the left of the chest, near the bottom edge of the image.
title: Wooden Chest
